title: Smoky German Sausage Hash
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring smoky sausage, onions, and bell peppers, all served atop a bed of crispy hash browns.
instructions: Cut the hash browns into thin strips and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with butter and toss to coat.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Meanwhile, cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the sausage is browned, remove it from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender.
Return the sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and bell pepper.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the sausage mixture over the crispy hash browns.
